parameters.fetchXml:
<fetch version="1.0" output-format="xml-platform" mapping="logical" distinct="false">
  <entity name="account">
    <attribute name="name" />
    <attribute name="accountid" />
    <filter type="and">
      <condition attribute="new_externalreference" operator="eq" value="@{variables('ClientExternalID')}" />
    </filter>
  </entity>
</fetch>

<fetch version="1.0" output-format="xml-platform" mapping="logical" distinct="false">
  <entity name="contact">
    <filter type="and">
      <condition attribute="new_isconsultant" operator="eq" value="1" />
      <condition attribute="new_externalreference" operator="eq" value="@{variables('ConsultantExternalRef')}" />
    </filter>
  </entity>
</fetch>

<fetch version="1.0" output-format="xml-platform" mapping="logical" distinct="false">
  <entity name="contact">
    <filter type="and">
      <condition attribute="new_iscandidate" operator="eq" value="1" />
      <condition attribute="new_externalreference" operator="eq" value="@{variables('CandidateExternalRef')}" />
    </filter>
  </entity>
</fetch>
